rule: The hand is not a flat two-dimensional shape without volume but a three-dimensional body form.
The palm from the centre of the wrist to the base of the middle finger is the same length as the middle finger.
If the base of the palm is level with the chin base, the fingers reach the brow and the middle finger touches the hairline.
A hand laid sideways on the brow fits almost exactly between the hairline and the eyebrows; the palm placed sideways at the nose base reaches the base of the chin.
Advancing top surfaces are light, receding side planes take intermediate tones, and underplanes farthest from the light take the deepest values.
